findings.reason: Confirmed: dark-light-choose returns its first argument on light themes (variables.scss:46-51), and the diff changes the light branch of the bold reply username link from 30% to 70% lightness, so default light sites now show a faint grey name.

Confirmed: the mobile .custom-message-length light-theme value goes from the old 70% to 30% (the arguments are swapped), while the desktop counterpart correctly uses 70%/30%; the visible regression is small.
Confirmed: the mobile topic-map h3 light-theme lightness changes from 20% to 50%, unlike desktop's 20%/80%, so light themes change in a PR meant only for dark themes.
Confirmed: desktop/user.scss .name changes from 30% to 50% in the light branch and now matches .title; it is a real but minor light-theme change that might be intentional.
Confirmed: mobile/user.scss has the same 30% to 50% light-theme change for .name as the desktop file, making it indistinguishable from .title.
